desc: Implement full solution: group by vitamin, per-vitamin at-most 0/1 knapsack over calories 0..X (descending loop, zeros init, prefix-max for monotonicity), binary search M, check sum of minimal per-vitamin calorie costs <= X, output largest feasible M.
Test the program on sample 1 (expect 3) and sample 2 (expect 0); both passed.
Analyze edge cases (empty vitamin group, answer 0) and complexity: O(N*X) DP plus O(log UB) search with monotone bisect — correct and within intended bounds.
Micro-optimize the DP inner loop (local variable binding, in-place descending update, cheap `if` form) which is the practical fast path in CPython.
